import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_3.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['WarNum', 'WhereFought'] and types are integer
    df = df[['WarNum', 'WhereFought']].copy()
    df['WarNum'] = df['WarNum'].astype(int)
    df['WhereFought'] = df['WhereFought'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
# we perform a union (concatenation) of all source tables
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target examples show duplicates exist (e.g., WarNum=1, WhereFought=2 repeated),
# so we do NOT drop duplicates to preserve tuple counts.

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables (all have the same schema)
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY WarNum (primary key) and aggregate WhereFought by min to ensure one row per WarNum
df_result = df_union.groupby("WarNum", as_index=False).agg({"WhereFought": "min"})

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column names
df_result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
